card_set: SPECIAL BOOSTER PACK That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime [UE20BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 Switch to active. May move to the front line.
[Activate: Main] #If on the Front Line# 『Once Per Turn』 Choose one character with 4000 or more base BP on your field other than . It loses all base abilities until the start of your next turn. Draw a card.
[Activate: Main] #If on the Front Line# 『Once Per Turn』 Choose up to one character with 1500 or more BP on your opponent's front line. It loses 1000 BP until the end of the turn. If you have four or more character cards with 4000 or more BP in your sideline, you may place one card from your hand into your sideline. If you do, choose up to one character on your energy line and move it to your front line.
